description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain activation and deactivation lifecycle, including scenarios like activation, deactivation, reactivation, long-running operations, and exception handling. It uses Xunit for testing and interacts with various grain interfaces to validate lifecycle behaviors.

classes.name: GrainActivateDeactivateTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying Orleans grain activation and deactivation lifecycle behaviors, including reactivation, exception handling, and complex scenarios.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources by clearing watcher calls.

methods.name: WatcherGrain_GetGrain
methods.description: Tests creation of a watcher grain reference.

methods.name: Activate_Simple
methods.description: Verifies that OnActivateAsync is called once upon first access.

methods.name: Deactivate_Simple
methods.description: Verifies that OnDeactivateAsync is called upon explicit deactivation.

methods.name: Reactivate_Simple
methods.description: Tests reactivation after deactivation, ensuring a new activation occurs.

methods.name: Activate_TailCall
methods.description: Tests activation with tail call optimization patterns.

methods.name: Deactivate_TailCall
methods.description: Tests deactivation with tail call patterns.

methods.name: Reactivate_TailCall
methods.description: Tests reactivation for tail call pattern grains.

methods.name: LongRunning_Deactivate
methods.description: Verifies deactivation and reactivation for grains with long-running operations.

methods.name: BadActivate_Await
methods.description: Ensures exceptions during activation are propagated correctly.

methods.name: BadActivate_GetValue
methods.description: Checks that method calls fail if activation fails.

methods.name: BadActivate_Await_ViaOtherGrain
methods.description: Verifies exception propagation through grain-to-grain calls.

methods.name: Constructor_Bad_Await
methods.description: Tests handling of exceptions thrown during grain constructor execution.

methods.name: Constructor_CreateGrainReference
methods.description: Verifies grain reference creation during constructor phase.

methods.name: TaskAction_Deactivate
methods.description: Tests deactivation of grains with Task-based activation logic.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdleWhileActivate
methods.description: Verifies handling when a grain attempts to deactivate during activation, expecting rejection.

methods.name: CheckNumActivateDeactivateCalls
methods.description: Helper method to verify the number of activation and deactivation calls recorded.

methods.name: AssertIsNotInvalidOperationException
methods.description: Helper to assert that an exception is not an InvalidOperationException and contains expected message.
